title: Nothing Crossed on Sunday

mood.label: Worn down, grinding on
mood.summary: Hormuz all but closed — five ships Saturday, none Sunday — while Ukraine's drones hit Russia, Flores' toll reached 53, and half of Europe's rivers ran to record lows. Lab breakthroughs and a revived salmon creek carried the only lift.

lines: Five ships Saturday. None on Sunday.
The strait holds its breath, the charts go flat.
The Rhine's down to stones, the Danube shows its bed —
half a continent drinking what's left.
drones across the border before it was light.
But a creek runs cold with young salmon,
and somewhere two hours of sleep came back.
